purpose: Four stylization and navigation variants of selected Starfall Codex; compact panels and a unified title/gameplay aesthetic
referencePolicy: Final titles were generated from text without the original high-detail reference; each supporting atlas uses its variant's final title as the style reference. Rejected drafts remain only in the generator's default source folder.

variants.name: Quiet Observatory
variants.short: A restrained celestial diorama with a compact chapter rail.
variants.style: Simple stylized cel-shaded 3D at a deliberately achievable small-game quality: visible low-poly shapes, two-tone matte shading, broad clean outlines, five-head-tall characters with flat face colors and tiny simple eyes. A simple pale-lilac bob, triangular witch hat, single navy robe and lilac cape define Vesper in six large color shapes, no fine embroidery, individual hair strands, complex accessories or portrait detail. Environments use chunky arches, large flat planes, floating stone fragments and a few crystal shapes; no realistic masonry, texture microdetail, film lighting, photographic depth of field or elaborate fantasy city. Magical impossible proportions and floating objects give the scene fantasy. Celestial ink navy, ivory, subdued gold and lilac. It should look like the actual small stylized 3D diorama a developer could render in Godot, rather than a high-end marketing illustration.
variants.navigation: A thin left chapter line with small labels; the active section opens one compact floating page. Back closes that page to the same diorama. Confirm sits at the bottom right of the active page.
variants.title: An open-roof impossible observatory, one crescent-shaped arch, a small floating book and five drifting crystal shards above a simple circular platform. An ordinary small 3D-looking Vesper stands at the right edge of the platform, about 130 pixels tall in a 1920x1080 frame. Most of the image is calm navy-purple sky with a sparse constellation, broad silhouettes and large uncluttered planes. Place ROOTWARD at upper left, about 380 logical pixels wide. Under it, a thin left chapter line with compact menu labels. No giant stone castle or enormous book; one achievable diorama reused as the in-game environment.

variants.name: Moonlit Storybook
variants.short: Flat illustrated moonlight, sparse page tabs and an ordinary sprite-sized witch.
variants.style: Whimsical fantastical 2D storybook game art: broad flat gouache shapes with just one soft shadow tone, slightly irregular ink outlines and a restrained paper texture in scenery only. Everything is drawn as reusable layered cutouts with simple silhouettes, not a realistic painting. variants.navigation: A short horizontal line of chapter tabs beneath the logo. Choosing a chapter reveals a small loose page hanging in the open sky; local folio controls turn the page. Home restores the same moonlit view.

variants.name: Starbound Toybox
